scientific_scope: Boel 2016 cross-protein nonsynonymous expression diagnostics only; not a fixed-protein synonymous-library mechanism test and not SOTA evidence
reference_scope: E. coli K-12 MG1655 RefSeq CDS; external codon-usage proxy for BL21(DE3), not a strain-matched or expression-weighted CAI reference
local_window_scope: first 48 nt of CDS; no 5'UTR is available

combined_model.standardization: train mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=0); no dev/test fitting
combined_model.selection: fixed a priori; no dev or test hyperparameter search

univariate_model: ordinary least squares on train, separately for each proxy; raw Spearman is also retained

stratification.scope: diagnostic strata, not length/GC OOD splits

bootstrap.multiple_testing: Holm across five primary proxy comparisons within each evaluation split
bootstrap.p_value: two-sided sign-tail bootstrap probability with plus-one correction

evaluation_order: compute sequence features without expression labels
prohibited_claims: use of MAGE functional_untouched for fitting, tuning, or this evaluation
